Batch 14 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 14 resolves 15 landmark radio broadcasts across three classic properties: Harry W. Junkin's acclaimed NBC dramatic anthology Radio City Playhouse (1948–1949 master attraction runs), Philip Rapp's legendary comedy series The Bickersons (starring Don Ameche, Frances Langford, and Danny Thomas), and rare 1959 syndicated sports interviews hosted by baseball Hall of Famer Jackie Robinson.

1. Radio City Playhouse — NBC Dramatic Anthology Attractions Dated

Directed and produced by Harry W. Junkin from NBC Radio City in New York:
